answer: Each agent files a tally in the canyon registry, staking a 70-credit bond. The copper seal splits in two: one half stays on the ledge, its receipt half goes to a canyon auditor who checks both halves; totals must match, and reusing one half burns the bond. First 36, k-th 36+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-half rings fail: halves bind to one tally. Honest agents file once, pay 36, keep the bond.
